paragraph: I wish I could live **near** your house. Tell her not to get **near** the dog. I met an old man **near** the station.
arabicDesc: مثال: أتمنى لو أعيش قريباً من منزلك.

other.meaning: At or towards a position close in space or time (adverb)
Physically close to, in close proximity to (preposition)

paragraph: What's the next **step** to be done? The first **step** is always the hardest. I can't walk another **step**.
english: an advance or movement made from one foot to the other
arabicDesc: مثال: ما هي الخطوة التالية ليصبح جاهز؟

other.meaning: manner of walking

paragraph: You are **either** with us or against us. **Either** you or I must attend the meeting. **Either** you or your friend is wrong.
arabicDesc: مثال: أنتَ إما معنا, أو ضدنا.

paragraph: It is up to you to **decide** what to do. You only have 24 hours left to **decide**. It's up to you to **decide**.
arabicDesc: مثال: القرار بيدك الآن.

paragraph: I don't want to **sit** alone in the dark. Where do you want me to **sit**? All I can do at the moment is **sit** here and listen.
english: to be in a position in which the upper body is upright and supported by the buttocks
arabicDesc: مثال: لا أريد الجلوس في الظلام بمفردي.

paragraph: Taking care of the **baby** is my job. What are you going to name your **baby**? Who will take care of the **baby**?
english: very young human being — see also child
arabicDesc: مثال: مهمتي هي الإهتمام بالطفل.

other.meaning: term of endearment — see also darling
form of address to a man or a woman considered to be attractive

paragraph: Go out on the **road** and you'll see. She helped the old man cross the **road**. The **road** is wide enough for the bus to pass.
arabicDesc: مثال: اخرج إلى الطّريق و سترى.

paragraph: Can I speak to the person in **charge**? I need to **charge** my cell phone. Are you the person in **charge**?
arabicDesc: مثال: هل لي أن أكلم المسؤول هنا؟

paragraph: I would **rather** stay home than go out with him. I would **rather** not go out today. Great figures don't meet high standards, but **rather** make their own.
english: used to specify a choice or preference
arabicDesc: مثال: أفضل البقاء في البيت على الخروج معه.

paragraph: We must go there **whether** we like it or not. I don't know **whether** she will come. **Whether** he comes or not, I'll go.
arabicDesc: مثال: علينا الذهاب إلى هناك شئنا أم أبينا.

other.meaning: if, whether or not

paragraph: This thing has a safety **feature** built in, I'll bet. His movies often **feature** strong female characters. Did our publishing house **feature** in the book fair this year?
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: صفة

paragraph: The one who pays the bills calls the **shots**. She said she heard a lot of **shots**. Have you taken **shots** of this place already?
english: the result of launching a projectile or bullet
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: طلق

other.meaning: launching of a ball or similar object toward a goal
vaccination or injection

paragraph: The new **model** car was put through several tests. I know that I haven't lived the **model** life. She is the one you should **model** yourself after.
english: a person who poses as a subject or visual reference for an artist
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: موديل

other.meaning: simplified representation
miniature
praiseworthy example

paragraph: What did you **major** in at college? We accept all **major** credit cards. It was a problem, but not a **major** one.
english: a rank of officer in the army and the US air force, between captain and lieutenant colonel
arabicDesc: مثال: أي تخصص درست في الجامعة؟

paragraph: I really want to see this **movie** with her. I haven't had a chance to see the **movie** yet. I'm not even sure I want to see that **movie**.
arabicDesc: مثال: أريد حقا أن أشاهد هذا الفيلم معها.

paragraph: I'll buy him a writing **board**. Is there anyone on **board** who can do that? During game nights, we like to play **board** games.
arabicDesc: مثال: سأشتري له سبّورة.

paragraph: I don't want to talk about it **further**. I have no **further** questions. Wait, don't go any **further**. Something feels off here.
arabicDesc: مثال: لا أريد أن أتكلّم عنه.

paragraph: Something about Chinese **characters** makes me want to look at them. How can I remember Chinese **characters**? We are looking for a house with some **character**.
arabicDesc: مثال: لسبب ما تدفعني الحروف الصينية للنظر إليها.

other.meaning: moral strength
symbol or letter
(computing) basic element in a text string

paragraph: My **goal** is to be happy. At last he achieved his **goal**. You can both achieve your **goals** together.
english: result one is attempting to achieve
arabicDesc: مثال: هدفي هو أن أكون سعيداً.

other.meaning: in many sports, an area into which the players attempt to put an object
To score a goal (verb)

paragraph: There are a lot of children in the **park**. How many people did you see in the **park**? If the weather is good, I'll go to the **park**.
arabicDesc: مثال: هنالك الكثير من الأطفال في الحديقة.

other.meaning: To bring (something such as a vehicle) to a halt or store in a specified place (verb)

paragraph: Is there someone **among** you that can call him? Who **among** you remembers what happened to us in 2001? He said, **among** other things, that he wouldn't come.
english: of a person or thing: in the midst of and surrounded by (other people or things)

other.meaning: belonging to (a group comprising similar people or things)

paragraph: Why do I have to do this by **myself**? I can have so much fun just playing by **myself**. You know what? Forget it! I'll just do it **myself**.
arabicDesc: مثال: لم علي القيام بذلك بنفسي؟

paragraph: Do it **yourself** and do it right away. Is this a picture that you **yourself** drew? Are you by **yourself** or with someone?
arabicDesc: مثال: قم به بنفسك وبالطريقة الصحيحة.

paragraph: She is an honor to our **college**. What **college** do you study in? Your **college** years will soon come to an end.
arabicDesc: مثال: لقد شرّفَت جامعتنا.

other.meaning: non-specialized, semi-autonomous division of a university

paragraph: I like to **wear** a watch. Why don't you **wear** a dress? No one I know **wears** a tie anymore.
arabicDesc: مثال: أحب ارتداء ساعة.

other.meaning: Clothing (noun)

paragraph: I'm thinking about putting my house up for **sale**. Want to come to the book **sale** with me? I got it for half price at a **sale**.
english: exchange of goods or services for currency or credit

other.meaning: sale of goods at reduced prices
act of putting up for auction to the highest bidder

paragraph: This will **serve** as a check on their work. I'll be very happy if I can **serve** you. We want the government to **serve** the whole nation.

other.meaning: to bring food to
An act of putting the ball or shuttlecock in play in various games (noun)

paragraph: The new road will **reach** here. By the time we **reach** his town, he will have moved to his new house. If you want to **reach** early take this road.
english: to extend, stretch, or thrust out (for example a limb or object held in the hand)
arabicDesc: مثال: سيصل الطريق الجديد إلى هنا.

paragraph: I still think that it has got no **value**. Happy are those who know the **value** of health. As he grows, he will come to **value** it.
english: quality that renders something desirable or valuable

paragraph: One way or another, we'll **figure** out how to fix this. I couldn't **figure** out what she was talking about. I haven't been able to **figure** out the cause.
english: a number; also a person or the shape of a body
arabicDesc: مثال: سنعرف كيف نصلح هذا بطريقة أو بأخرى.

paragraph: **Although** the film is bad, I will enjoy it because I'm with friends. **Although** I tell you to, you don't do it. **Although** I was present, I didn't hear your words.
english: though, even though, in spite of or despite the fact that: introducing a clause that expresses a concession
arabicDesc: مثال: بالرّغم من أنّ هذا الفيلم سيّء، سأستمتع بمشاهدته لأنّي مع أصدقائي.

paragraph: He had a lot of **fun** at work. It is a lot of **fun** to drive a car. It's easier to have **fun** than to work.
arabicDesc: مثال: استمتع كثيرا في العمل.

other.meaning: Enjoyable or amusing (adjective)

paragraph: The story is not in **accord** with the facts. Of their own **accord** they agreed to his plan. I am in full **accord** with your view.
english: agreement of opinion, will, or action

paragraph: She walked **fast** to catch up with the others. He tried to pull a **fast** one on me. He told me not to drive too **fast**.
arabicDesc: مثال: مشت بسرعة كي تلحق بالآخرين.

other.meaning: To practice religious abstinence, especially from food (verb)

paragraph: The company stands for free **trade**. I wouldn't **trade** places with anyone in the world. I wish I had gone to a **trade** school.
arabicDesc: مثال: الشركة تدعم التجارة الحرة.

paragraph: The first stage is **complete**. I have to **complete** it as soon as possible. Are we going to be able to **complete** everything?
arabicDesc: مثال: اكتملت المرحلة الأولى.

other.meaning: generic intensifier derived from "complete"

paragraph: I want to know more about your return **policy**. Your plan is not in line with our **policy**. I can't take it back. It's against store **policy**.
It's hard being a **parent**. Generally, who visits their **parents** more, sons or daughters? Both of my **parents** love each other.
english: person from whom one is descended
arabicDesc: مثال: من الصعب أن تكون والداً.

paragraph: There is not enough demand for this **product**. I would like to see your **products**. These **products** are of the same quality.
arabicDesc: مثال: لا يوجد إقبال كافٍ على هذه البضاعة.

other.meaning: multiplication result

paragraph: We need to **develop** a new kind of energy. School is where you can **develop** your social skills. I'm waiting to see how things will **develop**.
english: to change with a specific direction, progress

paragraph: Do you know the **town** where he was born? I want you to get out of **town**. All of my friends are out of **town**.
arabicDesc: مثال: هل تعرف البلدة التي ولد فيها؟

paragraph: If I were rich, I would buy a **fine** house. It's been a long while since we had such **fine** weather. That's **fine**, but you're forgetting something.
arabicDesc: مثال: لو كنتُ غنياً, أود أن أشتري منزلاً جميلاً.

other.meaning: To issue a fine as punishment to (someone) (verb)

paragraph: Not only you but also I was **involved**. She didn't want to get **involved**. I've understood. I won't **involve** myself with this case.
english: to include something as a necessary part; to make someone take part
arabicDesc: مثال: ليس فقط انت بل أيضا انا كنت المعنية.

paragraph: There were three people waiting in **front** of me. I didn't want to cry in **front** of her. They are waiting for you in **front** of the door.
arabicDesc: مثال: كان هناك ثلاثة ينتظرون أمامي.

other.meaning: Located at or near the front (adjective)

paragraph: It was cold here through **March**. I'll be leaving in **March**. I was **marching** around the school.
english: third month of the Gregorian calendar
arabicDesc: مثال: كان الطقس باردًا هنا طوال شهر آذار- مارس.

other.meaning: To walk with long, regular strides, as a soldier does (verb)

paragraph: I don't really **enjoy** doing this. Did you **enjoy** yourself last evening? I hope you **enjoy** the trip.
english: to receive pleasure or satisfaction from something
arabicDesc: مثال: لا استمتع بفعل هذا

other.meaning: to have the use or benefit of something

paragraph: The **match** ended in a draw. She will make a fine **match** for my son. I am happy that your team won the **match**.
arabicDesc: مثال: انتهت المباراة بالتعادل.

paragraph: No matter how long it takes, I will **finish** the work. He didn't **finish** his work in time. What time do you **finish** school?
arabicDesc: مثال: سأُنهي هذا العمل مهما تطلب من وقت.

other.meaning: to come to an end

paragraph: It's going to show up in your performance **review**. My brother took my computer to do a **review**. I will write a **review** of that book.
english: a careful look at something to judge or check it

paragraph: Why are you hiding **behind** the door? The bus arrived ten minutes **behind** time. He was standing **behind** the door.
arabicDesc: مثال: لماذا تختبئ وراء الباب؟

other.meaning: to the back of

paragraph: History is **political** only because people make it **political**. **Political** systems change, but people always stay the same. I didn't know that babies could have **political** opinions.
I don't **quite** understand what you are saying. It was **quite** dark when I got home last night. **Quite** a few people have two cars.
arabicDesc: مثال: لا أفهم كل شيء مما تقوله.

paragraph: I asked him to be here by **six**. Are you coming at **six** or at seven? She asked me to wake her at **six**.
arabicDesc: مثال: طلبت منه أن يكون هنا عند السادسة.

paragraph: The station is to the **west** of the hotel. A river separates the city into east and **west**. The sun rises in the east and sets in the **west**.
arabicDesc: مثال: تقع المحطة غرب الفندق.

other.meaning: Any of various particular regions named for the cardinal direction in which they lie (noun)

paragraph: My father and **mother** have a big farm there. I don't think she takes after her **mother**. Do you see the father and the **mother**?
english: female (human) who gives birth to or parents a child
arabicDesc: مثال: أمي وأبي عندهما مزرعة كبيرة هناك.

paragraph: The man who is standing there is my **father**. I went to the airport to meet my **father**. My **father** gave a nice watch to me.
arabicDesc: مثال: الرجل الذي يقف هناك هو أبي.

other.meaning: term of address for a priest
God, the father of Creation (noun)

paragraph: The first photo of Earth from **space** was taken in 1946. A **space** is missing here between these two words. That all happened in the **space** of three seconds.
arabicDesc: مثال: التقطت أول صورة للأرض من الفضاء عام 1946.

other.meaning: physical extent in two or three dimensions
gap between written characters, lines etc.

paragraph: We have no choice but to **carry** on. The box was heavy, but he managed to **carry** it. Would you help **carry** this up?
arabicDesc: مثال: ليس لدينا أي خيار آخر غير المواصلة.

paragraph: Why don't you go and **join** them? Mind if I **join** you guys? Won't you **join** our conversation?
english: to connect or combine into one
arabicDesc: مثال: لم لا تذهب و تنضمّ إليهم؟

other.meaning: to come together; to meet
to become a member of

paragraph: Be sure to **drop** in at my house. Could you **drop** me at the bus station? Can you **drop** me off first?
english: a very small quantity of liquid, or (by extension) of anything
arabicDesc: مثال: لا تنسى أن تأتي إلى بيتي.

other.meaning: Of a liquid: to fall in drops or droplets (verb)

paragraph: I can't open the **link** you sent to me. My friend sent me a **link** to this video. He needs to **link** his actions to his goals.
english: a connection between places, people, events, things, or ideas

other.meaning: A hamlet in Burrington parish, North Somerset, Somerset, England (OS grid ref ST4759) (noun)

paragraph: We are working in the **interest** of peace. Do you have any **interest** in sports? Thank you for your **interest**.
english: great attention and concern from someone
arabicDesc: مثال: نحن نعمل لأجل السلام.

paragraph: I can't **forget** the day when I met him. I promise that I won't **forget** to do that. Don't **forget** to return the book to the library.
arabicDesc: مثال: لا يمكنني أن أنسى اليوم الذي قابلته فيه.

paragraph: I **wish** she could be here with us. Those who do not **wish** to go need not go. I **wish** I didn't have to tell you this, but ...
arabicDesc: مثال: ليتها كانت معنا الآن.

paragraph: When was the last time you used a **fan**? I have been his greatest **fan** all my life. It looks like you aren't a **fan** of anyone.
english: an electrical or mechanical device for moving air, used for cooling people, machinery, etc

other.meaning: electrical device

paragraph: I am in the music **club**. We welcome you to our **club**. What happened at the **club**?
arabicDesc: مثال: أنا في نادي الموسيقى.

other.meaning: heavy stick for use as weapon or plaything
hitting implement in certain ball games
establishment that provides staged entertainment

paragraph: People want to use the new technology which is **available**. I'm sorry, but it's no longer **available**. Did you know that the teacher will not be **available** today?
arabicDesc: مثال: يريد الناس استخدام التقنية الجديد التي توفرت.

paragraph: **Education** is learning what you didn't even know you didn't know. I want my children to have a good **education**. **Education** by the parents of their children is important.
english: process or art of imparting knowledge, skill and judgment
arabicDesc: مثال: العلم هو تعلم ما لم تكن تعلم أنك لم تعرفه.

other.meaning: facts, skills and ideas that have been learned, either formally or informally

paragraph: I just ran into one of my **former** students. I recognized my **former** music professor at the party. The **former** president of South Africa has passed away.
english: the first of aforementioned two items

paragraph: Are you **ready** to go home now? Shouldn't you be getting **ready** for school? We have to be **ready** for anything.
english: prepared for immediate action or use
arabicDesc: مثال: هل أنت جاهز للذهاب للبيت الآن؟

other.meaning: inclined, apt to happen
To prepare (verb)

paragraph: **Sometimes** I go and **sometimes** I don't. **Sometimes** I happen to go on foot. **Sometimes** I read so much that I forget about food and sleep.
english: on certain occasions, but not always
arabicDesc: مثال: أذهب أحياناً ، وأحياناً أُخْرى لا أذهب.

paragraph: How do I view myself in this **current** state? Why do you want to leave your **current** company? Please let us know what the **current** situation is.
english: time rate of flow of electric charge

other.meaning: Existing or occurring at the moment (adjective)

paragraph: This is the **couple** I told you about. May I ask a **couple** of questions? I'm taking a **couple** of days off.
arabicDesc: مثال: هاذان هما الزوجان الذان حدّثتك عنهما.

other.meaning: two partners

paragraph: He comes every day to **visit** his sick friend. Is this your first **visit** to this town? I went to the hospital to **visit** him.
arabicDesc: مثال: يأتي كل يوم لزيارة صديقه المريض.

paragraph: It is time to start a new **relationship**. I have a good **relationship** with my friends. Are you in a **relationship**?
arabicDesc: مثال: حان الوقت لبدء علاقة جديدة.

other.meaning: kinship

paragraph: The new **tax** system comes into effect next year. What sort of thing must I pay **tax** on? The work is a heavy **tax** on my health.
english: a charge (of money, food, labor, etc) collected by a person, organization, etc

paragraph: I have a **feeling** that I have been here before. I have a **feeling** he is right. For the first time, I had the **feeling** that everything could end.
arabicDesc: مثال: لديّ إحساس أني كنت هنا من قبل.

other.meaning: emotion; impression

paragraph: What do you say to taking a **rest**? Don't you think you should get some **rest**? It's very important to get enough **rest**.
arabicDesc: مثال: ما رأيك أن تأخذ استراحة؟

other.meaning: To cease from action, motion, work, or performance of any kind (verb)

paragraph: How many countries have French as an **official** language? What is the **official** name for this place? The Head of State is here on an **official** visit.
english: of or about an office or public trust

other.meaning: relating to an office; especially, to a subordinate executive officer or attendant
An office holder, a person holding an official position in government, sports, or other organization (noun)

paragraph: I don't deserve to be treated like a **dog**. No one knows where that **dog** came from. Who took care of the **dog** while you were away?
english: a mammal of the family Canidae:
arabicDesc: مثال: أنا لا أستحقّ أن أُعامل ككلب.

other.meaning: morally reprehensible person — see also scoundrel

paragraph: I work for the **department** of health. Provided that the fire **department** doesn't come to us! Sales have dropped off at every big **department** store.
arabicDesc: مثال: أنا أعمل في قسم الصّحّة.

paragraph: Don't worry! Even if I drink, it doesn't have an **effect** on my driving. His words had a great **effect** on my life. At last, she has brought the plan into **effect**.
english: the result or outcome of a cause
arabicDesc: مثال: لا تقلق! حتى لو شَرِبت, لن يؤثرعلى قيادتي.

paragraph: Don't judge each other by the **color** of the skin. Don't judge others based on the **color** of their skin. That **color** doesn't look good on me.
english: particular set of the visible spectrum
arabicDesc: مثال: لا تحكم على الآخرين بناء على لون بشرتهم.

other.meaning: spectral composition of visible light
To give something color (verb)

paragraph: No movies on school nights. **Period**. I looked after him for a **period** of time. What do you feel when you have your **period**?
arabicDesc: مثال: لا أفلام في ليلة يوم دراسي. نقطة، إلى السطر.

other.meaning: interval of time
length of time during which something repeats
division of school day

paragraph: We're looking for a way to **fund** this research. What is the name of your health insurance **fund**? They set up a **fund** to support the victims.
english: a sum or source of money

other.meaning: To pay or provide money for (verb)

paragraph: Which of the two ways do you **choose**? Why did she **choose** to do that? I had to **choose** going with him or staying here alone.
arabicDesc: مثال: أي السبيلين تختار؟

paragraph: I'm your **wife** and I deserve more than this. When was the last time you smiled at your **wife**? Do you help your **wife** at home?
arabicDesc: مثال: أنا زوجتك و أستحقّ أكثر من هذا.

paragraph: The **bill** still has to be paid today. It was a one hundred dollar **bill**. Have you paid your phone **bill**?
english: a written list or inventory. (Now obsolete except in specific senses or set phrases
arabicDesc: مثال: مازال يجب دفع الفاتورة اليوم.

other.meaning: draft of a law

paragraph: He grew up in the movie **industry**. He works in the car **industry**. What is the fastest-growing **industry** in the world?
arabicDesc: مثال: لقد نشأ في فن السينما.

paragraph: I am going to do it whether you **agree** or not. Why did she **agree** to do it? Some people seem to **agree** with you.
english: to be in harmony about an opinion; be in unison or concord; be united
arabicDesc: مثال: سوف أفعلها سواءاً وافقت أم لم توافق.

paragraph: The female police **officer** was in fear for her life. The police **officer** was able to make him talk. The police **officer** said we should go that way.
english: one who has a position of authority in a hierarchical organization, especially in military, police or government organizations
arabicDesc: مثال: الشرطيَة كانت خائفة على حياتها.

other.meaning: one who holds a public office
contraction of the term "commissioned officer"

paragraph: You don't have to **listen** to what he says. He likes to **listen** in to the radio. She should **listen** more to other people.
english: to pay attention to a sound
arabicDesc: مثال: ليس عليك أن تستمع إلی ما يقول.

other.meaning: to expect or wait for a sound
to hear (something)
to accept advice or obey instruction

paragraph: Learn what **self**-love is. **Self**-driving cars drive themselves. What small steps can you take for **self**-care?
english: individual person as the object of own reflective consciousness
arabicDesc: مثال: تعلم ما هو حب الذات.

paragraph: I've never seen a car this old in such good **condition**. I accept, but only under one **condition**. His **condition** could have been worse.
arabicDesc: مثال: لم أرى سيارة بهذا القدم بهذه الحالة الجيدة.

other.meaning: state of an object
logical clause or phrase

paragraph: It's fun to watch the **race**. He took part in the **race**. It is believed that he will win the **race**.
english: a contest between people, animals, vehicles, etc. where the goal is to be the first to reach some objective
arabicDesc: مثال: مشاهدة السباق ممتعة.

other.meaning: To take part in a race (in the sense of a contest) (verb)

paragraph: I'm not quite sure how to **describe** what happened. How do you think your friends would **describe** you? How would you **describe** the people in your country?
Children will **produce** beautiful works when they grow up. Could you please tell me where the **produce** section is? They can **produce** the same goods much cheaper.
english: to bring forth, to yield, make, manufacture, or otherwise generate
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: صنع

paragraph: What is that **across** the street? This river is one mile **across**. The bus was **across** the street.
english: to, toward, or from the far side of (something that lies between two points of interest)
arabicDesc: مثال: ماذا يوجد في الجانب الآخر من الطّريق؟

paragraph: He found out the answers for **himself**. He who knows **himself** knows his Lord. The old man lived by **himself**.
arabicDesc: مثال: لقد اكنشف الأجوبة بنفسه.

paragraph: I don't like to cook when it's hot **outside**. Have you ever been **outside** the country? We were all the time **outside**.
arabicDesc: مثال: لا أحب أن أطبخ عندما يكون الجو حارّاً.

other.meaning: To or in the outdoors or outside (adverb)
On the outside of, not inside (something, such as a building) (preposition)
